Since all positive assertions in the claim (that it uses view-dependent, hardware-enforced, piecewise interpolation based on polygon subdivision) are directly supported by the text, and the text does not contradict the exclusion of the alternative method (implied by the specific description of the hardware scheme), the verdict is supported.
